A 40-year-old man from a hill-tribe village in <b>northern Thailand</b> had watery diarrhea and crampy abdominal pain after a festival where he ate <b>raw pork larb (larb moo)</b> made from a <b>wild boar</b>. Two weeks later he has high fever, <b>bilateral periorbital edema</b>, <b>severe myalgia</b> with muscle tenderness, a maculopapular rash, and <b>subungual splinter hemorrhages</b>. His blood shows <b>35% eosinophils</b> and a raised CK, and a <b>deltoid muscle biopsy</b> shows <b>coiled larvae inside nurse cells</b>.<br><br><b>What is the most likely causative pathogen?</b>	<b><i>Trichinella spiralis</i></b><div><small>Tissue nematode · encysted larvae in <b>nurse cells</b> (striated muscle)</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Trichinellosis</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td>GI phase: diarrhea, abdominal pain → muscle phase: <b>fever, severe myalgia</b>, rash</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Periorbital edema</b>, <b>subungual splinter hemorrhages</b>, muscle tenderness, <b>marked eosinophilia</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Ingest <b>raw / undercooked pork</b> (ลาบหมู) or <b>wild boar</b> with encysted larvae</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td><b>Northern Thailand</b> (hill-tribe feasts) · larvae in <b>skeletal muscle</b> (diaphragm, deltoid, gastrocnemius)</td></tr></table><ul><li>Dx: <b>muscle biopsy</b> (deltoid, gastrocnemius) — <b>nurse cell</b> with coiled larva; molecular ID, serology</li><li>Complications: <b>myocarditis</b>, CNS involvement, pneumonitis, thromboembolic disease</li><li>Tx: <b>mebendazole</b> หรือ <b>albendazole</b></li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 42–43 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED28 ข้อ 12 · MED27 ข้อ 19</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::tissue MED28-12 MED27-19
A 30-year-old woman from <b>central Thailand</b> who often eats <b>raw or undercooked freshwater fish</b> (catfish, snakehead), frogs, and chicken has <b>intermittent, migratory, painful, itchy swellings</b> on the abdomen and arm that move a few centimeters a day, and a <b>serpiginous creeping eruption</b>. Her blood shows <b>40% eosinophils</b>. The <b>third-stage larvae</b> have a head bulb with hooklets, <b>cats and dogs</b> are the definitive hosts, and larvae can invade the CNS.<br><br><b>What is the most likely causative pathogen?</b>	<b><i>Gnathostoma spinigerum</i></b><div><small>Tissue nematode · L3 larva with head-bulb hooklets</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Gnathostomiasis</b> (พยาธิตัวจี๊ด) — cutaneous / visceral larva migrans</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td><b>Intermittent migratory painful, pruritic swellings</b>; CNS: radiculomyelitis</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Migratory swelling</b> / creeping eruption + <b>marked eosinophilia</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td>Ingest raw <b>freshwater fish</b> (ปลาดุก, ปลาช่อน), frogs, snakes, poultry with L3 · definitive hosts: <b>cats, dogs</b></td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td><b>Thailand</b> & Southeast Asia, Japan, Latin America · subcutaneous tissue, viscera, CNS</td></tr></table><ul><li>Migration to other organs → <b>visceral larva migrans</b></li><li>Dx: <b>serology</b>, histology</li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 44–45 · ★ โจทย์เก่า MED27 ข้อ 23</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::tissue MED27-23
A 75-year-old <b>nursing home</b> resident and several staff members have <b>intense itching that is worse at night</b>. Examination shows small papules, excoriations, and thin <b>wavy grey burrows</b> in the <b>finger webs</b>, on the flexor wrists, elbows, axillae, and buttocks. An immunocompromised resident has <b>thick hyperkeratotic crusts</b> teeming with mites (the crusted, Norwegian form). A <b>skin scraping</b> of a burrow shows the female mite and her eggs.<br><br><b>What is the most likely causative pathogen?</b>	<b><i>Sarcoptes scabiei</i></b><div><small>Mite — female burrows in the stratum corneum</small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Scabies</b> (หิด) · crusted (Norwegian) scabies</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td><b>Intense itching, worse at night</b>; household contacts itchy too</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Burrows</b> + papules at <b>finger webs</b>, flexor wrists; crusted: thick crusts</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Direct skin-to-skin contact</b>; fomites (crusted scabies)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Worldwide, all ages; crowded settings · finger webs, wrists, elbows, axilla, buttocks, breast</td></tr></table><ul><li>Dx: <b>skin scraping</b> (excavate the female mite), dermoscopy, serology, molecular identification</li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 48–49</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::tissue
A 27-year-old woman has a <b>profuse, frothy, greenish-yellow vaginal discharge with a strong odor</b>, vulvar itching, irritation, and dysuria. Speculum examination shows <b>punctate hemorrhages on the cervix (strawberry cervix)</b>, and vaginal pH is 6.0. A <b>wet mount</b> shows <b>motile, pear-shaped flagellated trophozoites</b> with jerky movement. Her male partner has <b>no symptoms</b>, but <b>both partners must be treated</b>.<br><br><b>What is the most likely causative pathogen?</b>	<b><i>Trichomonas vaginalis</i></b><div><small>Flagellate · pear-shaped trophozoite, <b>no cyst stage</b></small></div><table><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">โรค</th><td><b>Trichomoniasis</b> (STD)</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">อาการ</th><td><b>Greenish-yellow frothy, foul-smelling discharge</b>, itching, dysuria</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">Sign</th><td><b>Strawberry cervix</b>; motile trophozoites on wet prep</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">พาหะ · การติดต่อ</th><td><b>Sexual</b> — treat all partners</td></tr><tr><th style="text-align:left;vertical-align:top;padding:2px 10px 2px 0;white-space:nowrap">ที่พบ</th><td>Vagina, urethra, prostate · men mostly asymptomatic carriers</td></tr></table><ul><li>Male: <b>urethritis, prostatitis</b>; majority asymptomatic</li><li>Dx: <b>wet prep</b> (motile flagellated trophozoites, POCT), <b>NAAT</b></li><li><b>Concurrent treatment of all sexual partners</b>; condoms prevent infection</li></ul><small>Parasitic infection · หน้า 49–50</small>	PathogenDx::Parasite::tissue
